additional_info.subject: Status Update
additional_info.body:
Today Giuseppe was onsite for a planned activity together with remote support.
FC14 was blinking red. Past experience proved that, due to an internal fault of the HMI, the HMI might have an abnormal current absorption, triggering the 8A fuse.
By disconnecting the F11-XD21.4C (power supply to HMI, hence HMI off) the fuse has no error.
Unfortunately, if FC14 trips, also the power supply to the routers is not provided and charger goes offline.
We tried to connect the power supply to the HMI in F11-XD24.12C, which is under FC17 (fuse with lowest load), but once powered on, the FC17 tripped as well.
In conclusion, the HMI has to be replaced.

Hi colleagues,
i'm proceeding to close this ticket after the substitution of HMI panel
On-site intervention report attached
